messages:
eldra: Auditor Maggie pinged about INC-2026-0601 — they need a concise evidence bundle focused on KMS usage and RBAC changes during the window 2026-05-15T01:00:00Z -> 2026-05-15T04:00:00Z. Request: key policy snapshots (current + any change history), CloudTrail events for Encrypt/Decrypt/GenerateDataKey, STS AssumeRole correlation, and a signed manifest. Can someone own collection and chain-of-custody?
forensics-bot: Evidence playbook checklist: include file->sha256 mapping, exporter identity, presign creator + CloudTrail PutObject entry, GPG detached signature (compliance signing key), time window, and control mapping (SOC2 CC6.2, ISO27001 A.9.2.1). Reference: https://redwood.internal/docs/compliance/export-playbook
pat: I can pull CloudTrail and KMS outputs. Quick clarifying Q: auditor asked for "key policy change history" 1 do we have archived policies or just current get-key-policy + CloudTrail API calls?
auditor-maggie: We prefer both: current get-key-policy snapshot and any CloudTrail events showing PutKeyPolicy or UpdateKeyDescription during the window +/- 24h. Also include list-grants and list-keys metadata showing KeyState and RotationStatus. A machine-readable access graph (GraphML or CSV) of principals -> keys is ideal.
eldra: Plan: 1) aws cloudtrail lookup-events for EventName: Encrypt/Decrypt/GenerateDataKey/PutKeyPolicy/AssumeRole 2) aws kms describe-key + get-key-policy + list-grants 3) export IAM role -> principal mappings and run tools/iam_graph.py to produce .graphml 4) collect kube RoleBinding diffs and kube-audit snippets 5) package into tar.gz, create sha256, GPG detach-sign, upload to s3://redwood-evidence/INC-2026-0601/, set Object Lock retention 30d and tag evidence:INC-2026-0601 6) record sts:GetCallerIdentity immediately before presign and include that json in manifest.
pat: Commands I'll run (short):
```
aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=EventName,AttributeValue=Encrypt --start-time "2026-05-15T01:00:00Z" --end-time "2026-05-15T04:00:00Z" > ct_encrypt.json
aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=EventName,AttributeValue=AssumeRole --start-time "2026-05-15T00:00:00Z" --end-time "2026-05-15T05:00:00Z" > ct_assumerole.json
aws kms describe-key --key-id arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123:key/faceb00c > kms_describe.json
aws kms get-key-policy --key-id arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123:key/faceb00c --policy-name default > key_policy.json
aws kms list-grants --key-id arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123:key/faceb00c > kms_grants.json
kubectl get rolebinding,clusterrolebinding -A -o yaml > all_rolebindings.yaml
python tools/iam_graph.py --keys key_arns.txt --output inc0601_access.graphml
```
svc-oncall: When uploading, capture sts:GetCallerIdentity and include the CloudTrail PutObject event key in manifest. Enable S3 Object Lock and set retention to 30 days. If presign is used, do not paste the URL in Slack.
eldra: We'll also add a short narrative timeline.md correlating KMS events, AssumeRole calls, and any RoleBinding changes with pod creation times. Include triage notes: who triaged, severity, remediation status, and PR links.
pat: Packaging steps:
```
tar czf inc0601_evidence_v1.tar.gz ct_*.json kms_*.json all_rolebindings.yaml inc0601_access.graphml kube-audit.json timeline.md
sha256sum inc0601_evidence_v1.tar.gz > inc0601.sha256
gpg --output inc0601.sig --detach-sign --local-user compliance@redwood-internal inc0601_evidence_v1.tar.gz
```
pat: Uploaded objects to s3://redwood-evidence/INC-2026-0601/ and created a presign with 7d expiry. I captured sts:GetCallerIdentity output and saved as presign_identity.json; CloudTrail PutObject key is archived: arn:aws:s3:::redwood-audit/CT/2026/05/15/putobject-xyz.json. Object Lock retention set.
auditor-maggie: For validation we expect: tar.gz SHA256 checksum, detached GPG signature, manifest.json mapping filenames->sha256->exporter identity, exported_at, presign_creator, presign_created_at, time_window, and control_map. Please include GPG public key fingerprint in manifest. If we need raw CloudTrail S3 objects for deeper validation we'll request them.
eldra: Quick manifest summary (will go into manifest.json): files: [ct_encrypt.json, ct_assumerole.json, kms_describe.json, key_policy.json, kms_grants.json, all_rolebindings.yaml, inc0601_access.graphml, kube-audit.json, timeline.md, inc0601_evidence_v1.tar.gz, inc0601.sha256, inc0601.sig, presign_identity.json]; exported_by: pat@redwood.com; exported_at: 2026-05-15T06:20:11Z; presign_creator: pat@redwood.com; presign_created_at: 2026-05-15T06:21:05Z; control_map: ["SOC2 CC6.2","ISO27001 A.9.2.1"]; gpg_fingerprint: "ABCD 1234 EF56 7890 0123 4567 89AB CDEF"
forensics-bot: Evidence package created: INC-2026-0601/evidence-v1. Follow the playbook for handoff and update evidence tracker.
auditor-maggie: Received package and signature. I'll verify checksum + GPG sig and follow up if we need additional artifacts (raw CloudTrail S3 objects or KMS decrypt logs). Thanks for the quick response :thumbsup:
eldra: Thanks team. I'll mark the evidence delivered in the tracker and prepare a short narrative for the control mapping review.
